splus.name: Malphite
splus.reason: Excellent into AD-heavy or fragile drafts. Even with a neutral lane, his ultimate gives a very clear fight condition.

splus.name: Shen
splus.reason: Less dominant in pure lane, but excellent at protecting a carry, playing the map, and turning cross-map plays.

splus.name: Mordekaiser
splus.reason: Mordekaiser holds S+ on the current patch: that is the level supported by their results and by the external sources we track. Win rate 50.5% at 11.0% pick rate.

splus.name: Teemo
splus.reason: Disrupts some melee matchups and controls zones, but often weakens the composition's frontline.

splus.name: Rammus
splus.reason: Rammus is an excellent answer to AD and auto-attack compositions, but his ranking heavily depends on the enemy draft.

splus.name: Nocturne
splus.reason: Nocturne is very strong at punishing side lanes and creating global pressure, but depends on good targets and clean ultimate timing.

splus.name: Ekko
splus.reason: Ekko has good AP scaling and real assassination potential, but requires clean timings and well-calculated entries.

splus.name: Amumu
splus.reason: Amumu is very stable in solo queue: fast clear, simple ganks, and huge ultimate value in grouped fights.

splus.name: Hwei
splus.reason: Hwei holds S+ on the current patch: that is the level supported by their results and by the external sources we track. Win rate 56.7% at 13.8% pick rate.

splus.name: Morgana

splus.name: Syndra
splus.reason: Syndra moves from B to S+: current-patch results place him clearly higher. Win rate 52.4% at 13.3% pick rate.

splus.name: Brand

splus.name: Ashe
splus.reason: Ashe compensates for less explosive damage with huge vision value, long-range engage, and constant control.
